name: Fray Island
summary: Warriors gather on Fray Island, off the Merchant Coast of the Barrens. On this rocky islet, fighters from across Azeroth test their skill in a rough training ring.

sections.title: A Proving Ground for Brawlers
sections.body: Off the eastern bluffs of the Barrens, Fray Island lies beyond the watchful eyes of Orgrimmar and Theramore. Warriors of every race and creed train here. Klannoc Macleod oversees the fighting arena at the island’s heart. Seasoned fighters and raw recruits meet there in brutal brawls.

sections.title: The Trial of the Affray
sections.body: Despite the hostile waters around it, Fray Island’s ring follows a simple code of martial combat. At their trainers’ direction, warriors face The Affray, a grueling gauntlet against waves of challengers. The trial ends with a bout against champion Big Will. In the ring, Horde and Alliance allegiance gives way to strength and martial discipline.

faq.q: What is Fray Island used for?
faq.answer: Fray Island is a training ground for warriors and the site of The Affray, a brutal combat trial. Warriors from both factions test their endurance and master advanced stances there.
No kingdom or faction rules Fray Island. Warriors of every race and creed train there, while Klannoc Macleod oversees the combat ring.

faq.q: How do I reach Fray Island?
aliases: how to get to fray island
faq.answer: Fray Island lies in the Great Sea, off the Barrens’ eastern coast and south of Ratchet. Reaching it means swimming a long way from shore through waters filled with sharks and frenzy.
The Affray is an endurance trial held in Fray Island’s fighting cage. A warrior stands atop the grate and defeats successive waves of challengers before facing brawler Big Will.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can test your discipline and strength at Fray Island’s training ground. Klannoc Macleod and The Affray test whether you can adopt the Berserker Stance.
Klannoc Macleod is human, but the warriors who gather in his ring share a bond of combat across racial lines.
